steps.content: [Background - Suite Parlor] [Darkening Filter]

To prevent anyone from breaking in during the night, you've pushed the low cabinet against the door, wedging it firmly against the handle. Now, even if someone manages to force their way in, you'll be woken up by the noise before they can reach you.
With your defenses in place, you lie down and drift off to sleep to the rhythmic sounds of the train rolling forward.
...Until you're jolted awake by a scream.
The scream came from somewhere close—one of the neighboring rooms, it seems. You force your eyes open and glance at your watch:
What happened? Was someone attacked? You spring out of your bed and hurry to the door. Footsteps echo down the corridor, followed by voices in the distance.

steps.speaker: Corridor Voices
steps.content:
<color=#7683a2><size=28>...Someone was in my room! ...Couldn't see... vanished...
...Stay calm, I'll get someone to investigate!</color></size>
Someone jogs away. You carefully move the cabinet aside and open the door slightly, only to find a corridor that's plunged into darkness once more.
Another power outage? You stay put out of caution. Soon, multiple sets of footsteps approach from the other end of the corridor. This time, the voices are clearer.

steps.speaker: Corridor Voices
steps.content:
<color=#7683a2><size=28>The circuit breaker's broken... Don't worry, I've already asked Mr. William from Room 102 to fix it.
I brought a spare lantern. Are you alright?</color></size>
The door opens, followed by sounds of things being moved around. Not long after, the attendant and Carl step out of the room and go their separate ways. Seems like they found nothing.
You secure the door once more. The power still hasn't been restored. You check your watch again.
You return to bed and close your eyes, trying to embrace sweet dreams...
[Screen shakes, sound of glass shattering, sighing sound]

steps.speaker: Compartment Voice
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=28>...</color></size>
This time, the sound is much closer. You can tell it's coming from Clementine's compartment.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Clementine?
No response.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: I heard something break. Do you need any help?
You knock on the compartment door. Soon, a muffled female voice comes from within.

steps.speaker: Voice from the Compartment
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>I'm fine. I can clean it up myself.</color>
Upon hearing a response, you lie back down, now reassured. You drowsily glance at your watch before drifting off.
You close your eyes, and the dream world welcomes you once more.
You faintly hear sounds from the corridor. The attendant has returned, and Carl is speaking with her. It seems like he's asking for a fresh towel.
Click—the power seems to be back on. Then, heavy footsteps pass by. The attendant is thanking William for fixing the circuit breaker...

The sounds outside grow increasingly muffled, gradually blending into an indistinct hum. The land of dreams beckons—there, you will find no murder mystery or culprit. Only the warmest, most peaceful darkness awaits.
Finally, with no further disturbances, you fall into a deep slumber...
[Background - Suite Parlor]

Morning comes, and you wake to the gentle sunlight shining on your face. It's still fairly early. You get up and freshen up, noticing that Clementine's door remains closed. She's probably still asleep.
Before Clementine wakes, perhaps you can begin going over the suspicious points from yesterday's investigation.
[Background - Dining Car]

In the dining car, William "Rusty Nail" sits in the furthest corner, just like yesterday. Meanwhile, Mrs. Jones seems to have mistaken someone else for her child again, insisting they eat the broccoli that came with their sausage.

The dining car is gradually filled up with passengers. Before long, Carl enters as well. He nods, greeting you, but politely declines your invitation to join you for breakfast. He looks rather unwell, so you don't press the matter.
You return to your table and examine the letter once more, scrutinizing the traces left by each pasted character.
Gradually, the sunlight shifts from your face to below your feet. The dining car empties as breakfast time draws to a close. You raise your hand to call over the attendant.

steps.speaker: Attendant Allison
steps.content: Coming! How may I help you?

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: My roommate doesn't seem to be up yet. Could you bring breakfast to our room?

steps.speaker: Attendant Allison
steps.content: No problem. Ms. Clementine in Room 104, correct? I'll be right there.
After the attendant leaves with the tray, you wait for a long time. Until...

steps.speaker: Attendant Allison
steps.content: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!
You step into the corridor and run toward the room at the far end.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: A power outage, complete darkness... It's the perfect opportunity to strike. So tell me, why hasn't our killer made their move yet?
Your conversation from last night echoes in your mind. An ominous feeling begins to take hold of you.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: You came rushing in so quickly once you heard me scream... Were you worried about me? Weren't you afraid the attacker might still be in here?
Your heart beats faster and faster. Your footsteps, too, grow heavier along with the pounding.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: My, looks like you caught me red-handed. You're absolutely right—my sworn enemy is on this train, trembling in fear at this very moment, terrified I might come knocking.
Don't tell me—
[Background - Suite Parlor]

You burst into Room 104. The room is shrouded in darkness. The curtains aren't completely closed, allowing a sliver of pale light to cut through, casting a narrow shadow that falls between the bed and the floor.

The partition door stands open. Clementine lies on the bed, body curled up slightly, head tilted to one side. Her expression is serene, as if she'd finally drifted into sleep after a long, sleepless night.
[Small CG - Crime Scene]
Blood spreads from beneath her body, dark red stains extend outward on both sides, like a pair of torn butterfly wings, still struggling to unfold.
A faint scent of incense drifts from the compartment, mingling with the metallic smell of blood—it's sickeningly sweet and deeply unsettling.
Beside her hand lies a blood-stained note, half-burned. Still, you are able to make out several large, messy characters scrawled across it:
Sinner Don't forget The Burning Redwood
[Background - Clementine's Study]
The Burning... Redwood...?
You find an illustration right next to the last line of text, tucked between the manuscript pages.
Your gaze is drawn to the image. Splattered blood, a dead woman, and...
Placed beside the woman's hand is something that shouldn't exist in this <color=#fb9259>fictional world</color>.
This is...
Wasn't this supposed to be a retro setting without any communication devices? Before you can voice the question, your own terminal rings.
Notification sounds ring out in succession—it's Nightingale. The messages roll down, finally stopping on a link. It's...

Clementine stands before you, her smile as gentle as ever. An eerie, spectral glow emanates from the butterfly ornament at her neck, as if it's about to come alive. Still, it remains firmly pinned in place.
On your screen, a line of red text stands out—
[Brief Pause]
N.F. 105 Eastside Fire "The Burning Redwood"
